meta.title: WNG chart of accounts profile: existing WNG chart plus the missing control and posting accounts (Report 54)
meta.authority: WNG decision 2026-09-28: keep WNG's chart (D3 Option A) and create the genuinely missing accounts. Mappings to existing WNG accounts carry the evidence recorded in Report 53. The accountant's sign-off is still required before this profile is activated in production (FINANCE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE=wng).
meta.activation: Set FINANCE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE=wng. Accounts are created by `php artisan finance:complete-chart --profile=wng --execute --confirm=<database>`, which is idempotent and never modifies an existing account.
meta.coding_convention: WNG codes are a mnemonic prefix plus a 3-digit sequence (AR-001, COS-008), with QuickBooks-style 'Parent:Child' names. New accounts use a new, unused prefix, or the next free number in an existing WNG family (COS-021..023). Each new header is non-postable; its children are postable.

new_accounts.name: Sales
new_accounts.rationale: Header matching WNG's QuickBooks 'Sales' parent (history codes to 'Sales:Printing'). Non-postable: revenue posts to a child.

new_accounts.name: Sales:Project Revenue
new_accounts.rationale: The only revenue account among the 120 is RI-001 Return Inwards. Invoices earn into one default revenue account; the invoice UI never selects a per-line revenue account (revenue_account_id is never sent). Revenue by line of business is already available from the enquiry/project dimension, so one account is sufficient.

new_accounts.name: Output VAT Payable
new_accounts.rationale: VAT charged on WNG's invoices (W1). WNG is VAT-registered: its chart has VP-001 Vat Penalty, and the eTIMS claim gate is live.

new_accounts.name: Input VAT Recoverable
new_accounts.rationale: Recoverable VAT on supplier bills and coded spend (W2, W3). Kept separate from output VAT because the VAT return reports them separately.

new_accounts.name: Withholding Tax Payable
new_accounts.rationale: WHT that WNG deducts from supplier payments (W2). There is no WHT receivable: receivables never record tax withheld by a client.

new_accounts.name: Payroll liabilities
new_accounts.rationale: Header in WNG's own terminology (history codes to 'Payroll liabilities:Net Pay' and 'Payroll liabilities:Helb Repayment').

new_accounts.name: Payroll liabilities:PAYE
new_accounts.rationale: The payroll accrual credits PAYE separately (W6).

new_accounts.name: Payroll liabilities:Statutory & Other Deductions
new_accounts.rationale: The payroll engine posts ONE pooled leg: gross minus net minus PAYE, which covers NSSF, SHIF, housing levy, HELB and other deductions, plus the employer's NSSF and housing-levy share. Separate NSSF, SHIF and housing-levy accounts would receive nothing until the engine splits that leg (Report 54 section 8).

new_accounts.name: Accrued Expenses
new_accounts.rationale: Goods received not yet invoiced (GRN accrual) and the liability allocated by spend vouchers (W2, W4). One account: the engine has a single accrual function and no separate procurement-clearing function.

new_accounts.name: Client Deposits
new_accounts.rationale: A client receipt that no invoice has earned yet is held here, not in Sales (W1). Applied to an invoice when allocated.

new_accounts.name: Inventory Asset
new_accounts.rationale: WNG's own QuickBooks name (20 petty-cash history lines code to 'Inventory Asset'). Stores is perpetual: a receipt debits it, and an issue or count credits it (W5). INV-001 is Inventory Shrinkage, an expense.

new_accounts.name: Work in Progress
new_accounts.rationale: Header for project cost carried on the balance sheet until it is billed. Having the accounts does NOT decide the timing policy (see wip_policies).

new_accounts.name: Work in Progress:Materials
new_accounts.rationale: Twin of COS-008.

new_accounts.name: Work in Progress:Direct Labour
new_accounts.rationale: Twin of PE-007; W7 Finance verify posts direct labour here.

new_accounts.name: Work in Progress:Subcontractors
new_accounts.rationale: Twin of COS-020.

new_accounts.name: Work in Progress:Transport & Delivery
new_accounts.rationale: Twin of COS-016.

new_accounts.name: Work in Progress:Equipment Hire & Site
new_accounts.rationale: Twin of COS-021.

new_accounts.name: Work in Progress:Project Utilities
new_accounts.rationale: Twin of COS-022.

new_accounts.name: Work in Progress:Field Facilitation
new_accounts.rationale: Twin of COS-006.

new_accounts.name: Work in Progress:Venue & Permits
new_accounts.rationale: Twin of COS-023.

new_accounts.name: Work in Progress:Rework & Warranty
new_accounts.rationale: Twin of COS-018.

new_accounts.name: Cost of Sales:Equipment Hire & Site
new_accounts.rationale: 5 job-required expense codes (plant, equipment and site costs of a job). WNG's OPE-013 Equipment Rental is an operating expense and would take job cost out of gross margin.

new_accounts.name: Cost of Sales:Project Utilities
new_accounts.rationale: 4 job-required expense codes. UTIL-001 and OPE-012 are WNG's office utilities, not a job's.

new_accounts.name: Cost of Sales:Venue & Permits
new_accounts.rationale: 4 job-required expense codes (venue fees and event permits). OPE-017 Licenses and permits is WNG's own business licensing.

new_accounts.name: Prepayments & Deposits
new_accounts.rationale: Header for money paid out ahead of the goods, service or refund it buys.

new_accounts.name: Prepayments & Deposits:Supplier Advances
new_accounts.rationale: Catalogue code for advances to suppliers; cleared by the supplier's invoice.

new_accounts.name: Prepayments & Deposits:Refundable Deposits
new_accounts.rationale: Catalogue code for venue, utility and rent deposits; cleared on refund.

new_accounts.name: Prepayments & Deposits:Prepaid Expenses
new_accounts.rationale: Catalogue codes for insurance and subscriptions paid ahead; expensed over the period covered.

new_accounts.name: Office Improvement
new_accounts.rationale: WNG's own QuickBooks fixed-asset name (petty-cash history codes to 'Office Improvement'; ADM-003 depreciation exists). Takes the leasehold-improvement capex code.

bank_default.note: Default operating bank; the seeded operating source is 'Equity Bank – Operating Account'.

accounts_receivable.note: AR-002 is EUR; the ERP invoices in KES.

staff_advances.note: Short Term Debtors. Trade debtors are AR-001 and no history uses STD-001 for anything else, so staff imprest is its natural use. A separate account is needed only if WNG uses STD-001 for other debtors.

net_payroll_payable.note: Reused: 2160 Net Payroll Payable (added by migration 2026_08_24_000001). WNG's QuickBooks 'Payroll liabilities:Net Pay' was not in the export, so the chart holds no duplicate.

cos_direct_labour.note: Personnel Expenses:Wages-Direct Labour. Not duplicated as a COS account: gross margin reads account_type, not the name hierarchy, so classifying PE-007 as direct_cost (an open accountant decision) is enough.

inventory_adjustments.note: Inventory Shrinkage; count GAINS post here too (net shrinkage).

salaries_expense.note: Personnel Expenses:Salaries. The ERP-added 7550 duplicates it and is not used.

bank_charges.note: WNG's FIN-005 Mpesa charges stays for M-Pesa fees if Finance splits fees by paying account later.

wip_policies.note: HOW cost is carried is a Finance policy, not a chart fact. 'capitalise' is what the engine implements: project cost is debited to WIP on capture and released to Cost of Sales pro rata as the job is invoiced. 'expense_on_capture' maps each WIP function onto its Cost of Sales twin, so cost reaches the P&L when captured; the release then has nothing to move, because it skips a family whose WIP and COS accounts are the same. Selected by FINANCE_WIP_POLICY. Still OPEN for Finance confirmation.

2300.note: NOT CONFIGURED — NO CURRENT EVIDENCE (Report 55). No loan liability among WNG's accounts or in history; FK-001 Faulu Kenya is recorded as an ASSET. The one loan-repayment code (NE-016) stays inactive, and readiness treats this as intentional, not as a configuration gap.

6600.note: Consumables; WNG has no separate safety account.

7150.note: WNG's Stationery & Printing, not the ERP-added 7150.

payment_source_notes.why_explicit: The seeder names every bank by the generic reference 1010. Translated through a map, Stanbic, KCB, Family and Card would all have linked to Equity Bank. A profile therefore names each source's account explicitly, and null means 'leave unlinked'.
payment_source_notes.MPESA: KEEP UNLINKED — WNG DECISION REQUIRED. Evidence (source snapshot): 63 of 160 client receipts arrived by M-Pesa, and petty cash books M-Pesa fees (70 lines to FIN-005 Mpesa charges); every petty-cash disbursement is recorded as 'cash', and top-ups come from NCBA, Equity and KCB. Nothing establishes whether M-Pesa is a WNG-held balance (till/wallet) or a channel settling into a bank. Disabled until linked.
payment_source_notes.CARD: KEEP UNLINKED — WNG DECISION REQUIRED. No evidence of a company card anywhere in the source: no payment method, no account, no description (the 'Visa' hits are the client VISA CEMEA). Disabled until linked.

2160.reason: Net Payroll Payable. WNG's equivalent ('Payroll liabilities:Net Pay') was not in the export, so the chart has no duplicate. net_payroll_payable maps here.

7150.reason: Office Supplies & Stationery duplicates OPE-030 Stationery & Printing, which the catalogue now uses. Left active and unchanged; Finance may deactivate it once confirmed (no posting reaches it).

7550.reason: Salaries & Wages duplicates PE-006 Personnel Expenses:Salaries, which salaries_expense now uses. Left active and unchanged; Finance may deactivate it.

not_created.name: Printing / Branding / Fabrication / Events-Exhibition / Signage / Merchandise revenue sub-accounts
not_created.reason: No ERP path posts to a per-line revenue account (the invoice UI never selects one), and revenue by line of business comes from the enquiry/project dimension. Add a child of SAL-001 if the accountant wants it in the ledger itself.

not_created.name: NSSF Payable, SHIF/SHA Payable, Housing Levy Payable (separate)
not_created.reason: The payroll accrual posts one pooled leg (PL-003). Separate accounts would receive nothing until the engine splits that leg by authority; recommended as a follow-up.

not_created.name: NITA Payable
not_created.reason: Payroll does not compute NITA (PE-004 Nita Levy is WNG's expense account, booked outside payroll).

not_created.name: Withholding Tax Receivable / Credit
not_created.reason: Receivables never record tax a client withheld.

not_created.name: Inventory Clearing / Goods Received Not Invoiced (separate)
not_created.reason: The GRN accrual posts to the single accrued_expenses function (AE-001).

not_created.name: Procurement clearing
not_created.reason: No engine function; AP-001 and AE-001 carry the procurement liabilities.

not_created.name: Staff Advances (separate)
not_created.reason: STD-001 Short Term Debtors serves it (see functions.staff_advances).

not_created.name: Cost of Sales:Direct Labour (separate)
not_created.reason: PE-007 Wages-Direct Labour serves it; a duplicate would be cosmetic.

not_created.name: Loans payable
not_created.reason: No evidence WNG carries a loan liability (see catalogue.2300).

existing_classification.note: MIG-D3b, applied in the REHEARSAL by `finance:complete-chart --classify-existing` (Report 55). Fills account_type and normal_balance ONLY where they are NULL; a different non-null value is refused, never overwritten. Code, name, id, parent, postability and balances are never touched. Accountant sign-off before production.

AR-002.note: EUR receivable; the ERP invoices in KES. Classified as recorded.

FK-001.note: Faulu Kenya is recorded by WNG as an ASSET; classified as recorded. Whether it is actually a loan is the accountant's (Loans Payable not configured).

NIC-001.note: USD bank account; classified as recorded.

COS-017.note: "Discounts given - COS": WNG books it within Cost of Sales; kept as direct cost as WNG presents it.

COS-019.note: "Overhead - COS": production overhead within cost of sales, so `overhead`, not direct.

EXD-001.note: Excise duty: operating expense as WNG records it.

OTE-001.note: Overtime expense: no history; operating by name. Confirm it is not direct project labour.

PE-007.note: The existing WNG direct-labour project-cost account (cos_direct_labour).

RI-001.note: Return Inwards is contra-revenue. Its normal balance stays CREDIT so the P&L (which signs by normal balance) shows returns as a deduction from revenue; a debit normal balance would ADD them to revenue.

WE-001.note: Wage expenses: no history; operating by name. Confirm it is not direct project labour.

unclassified_pending_decision.EQE-001: "Equity in earnings of subsidiaries" is recorded as EQUITY, but in QuickBooks it is normally an income-statement item. The category itself is ambiguous; left unclassified.
unclassified_pending_decision.ITX-001: Income tax expense: a tax charge below operating profit. None of direct_cost / overhead / opex is correct, and the ERP has no tax section. Left unclassified.
unclassified_pending_decision.LDO-001: Loss on discontinued operations, net of tax: below-the-line. Left unclassified for the same reason.
unclassified_pending_decision.OPE-026: Set Up Casuals: could be project setup labour (direct cost) or general casual labour (opex). No history line uses it, so there is no evidence either way. Left unclassified; the P&L shows it under `unclassified` until the accountant decides.

payment_source_state.note: A paying account with no ledger account is DISABLED until Finance links it, rather than given an invented account. `finance:complete-chart --disable-unlinked-sources` does this only while the source is unlinked and no document uses it. Re-enable it on the paying-accounts screen once it is linked.
